name: Suomi

skills.name: Pelting Snowflake
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Winter's Wrath
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles, dealing Freeze damage equal to 100% of attack to them. This skill's critical rate is reduced by 100%, but additionally deals fixed damage equal to 50% of defense. For each allied unit within 6 tiles, increases Stability Damage dealt by 1 point.

skills.name: Snow's Grace
skills.description: Select 1 allied target (excluding self) within 6 tiles and apply Frost Barrier for 2 turns. Frost Barrier absorption amount is equal to 130% of Suomi's initial attack, but cannot exceed 100% of the target's max HP. Restore 2 Stability Index. For each enemy unit within 5 tiles of the selected target, apply 1 stack of Defensive Support for 2 turns.

skills.name: Snowfield's Radiance
skills.description:
Selects 1 empty tile within 6 tiles, dealing fixed damage equal to 50% of defense to all enemy targets within 3 tiles, applying 2 stacks of Avalanche.

Restores 2 points of stability, cleanses 1 debuff, and cleanses the effect of Taunt from all allied units. Additionally, applies Frost Barrier and 1 stack of Wintry Bastion for three turns. Frost Barrier absorbs damage equal to 100% of Suomi's initial attack, up to a maximum of 100% of the target's max HP.

After this skill is used, generates Frost tiles in a snowflake-shaped area within a 3 tile radius around the selected tile for 3 turns.

skills.name: Source of Warmth
skills.description:
At the end of the action, gains 2 points of Confectance Index, restores 5% of Suomi's max HP to other allied units within 6 tiles. If the target's HP is below 50%, increases the amount restored to 10%.

When allied units (excluding Suomi) use basic attacks or skills, Suomi applies 1 stack of Avalanche to a random enemy target within 6 tiles of herself.

When an enemy unit within range takes targeted damage from an ally, prioritizes using Action Support once, dealing Physical damage equal to 80% of attack and 3 Stability Damage. Applies Critical Damage Up I to the allied unit for 2 turns. This can be triggered twice per turn. When HP is above 80%, gains Sleepdrift Sprint.

fortification.effect:
Increases the number of stacks of Avalanche by 1.

Recovers HP equal to 30% of Suomi's maximum HP and restores Stability Index by 4 points to all allied units. All allied units (excluding self) gain an additional 1 stack of Wintery Bastion.

If an allied unit is at full HP before being healed, they gain an additional 1 stack of Shelter and Continuous Healing I for 3 turns.

If allied units have Frost Barrier, apply Warding Light to them.

The effect Speedrift Sprint is enhanced, support range is increased by 2 tiles.
Apply Impact Response I to the target for 2 turns. for each surrounding large enemy unit, apply 1 additional stack of Defensive Support.
If it causes Stability Break, increases fixed damage to 125% of defense.

Additional effect Warding Light is added: when attacked, if Frost Barrier is not broken, inflict 1 point of Stability Damage to the attacker.

Support Actions now trigger an additional 1 time per turn, and recovers 1 point of Stability Index for other allied units within 4 tiles around the user.

Applies Defense Up II to all allied units for 3 turns. Increases the number of cleansed debuffs by 2, and also cleanses the effects of Fear, Infatuated, and Stun. Increases restored HP by 50% of Suomi's max HP. Expand the radius of Frost by 1 tile.

The effect of Shield is enhanced by 30%, up to a maximum of 150% of the target's max HP.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Unyielding Momentum
keys.effect: After using the active skill Winter's Wrath, if the target goes into / is in Stability Break, restores 2 points of Soumi's Stability.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Little Guardian
keys.effect: At the start of the battle, gain 3 points of Confectance Index.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Positive Feedback
keys.effect: When using the active skill Snow's Grace, if the target's HP is below 80%, gain 1 point of Confectance Index.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Move Swiftly
keys.effect: At the start of your turn, for each allied unit (excluding self) whose HP is below 80%, increase this unit's mobility by 1 tile.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Immovable
keys.effect: When inflicted with Stun, Taunt, or Paralysis, immediately cleanse that effect and become immune to Stun, Taunt, or Paralysis for one turn. Simultaneously, gain Frost Barrier for 3 turns. Frost Barrier absorbs damage equal to 60% of base attack, up to a maximum of 100% of Suomi's max HP. This can trigger only 1 time per battle.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Logistics Support in Progress
keys.effect: At the end of this unit's action, if this unit's stability is greater than 0, recovers 10% of this unit's maximum HP and 1 point of stability.

keys.name: Common Key - Mission's Blessing
keys.effect: DEF +5.0% / When HP drops below 80%, restore 15% of this unit's maximum HP and gain Defense Up III for 2 turns. Can trigger only once per battle.

keys.name: Expansion Key
keys.effect:
Action Support deals Freeze damage instead

When allies have Frost Barrier, increases Freeze damage dealt by 15% and restores 4 Stability at the start of the round. Before allies attack, if they do not have Frost Barrier, Suomi immediately applies Frost Barrier on them for 2 turns. Frost Barrier absorbs damage equal to 60% of Suomi's initial attack, up to a maximum of 100% of the target's max HP

Snowfield's Radiance: This skill applies Ice Seal for 2 turns
